body:

Amira

subject: G-559-084 — unscheduled headache assessment completed
body:
Hi all,

G-559-084 came in on 22 Sep during ATE for a severe migraine. It interrupted his usual activities for the day. Dr Ortiz assessed him, gave treatment locally, and documented severe/non-serious: no inpatient admission, immediate threat to life, persistent disability, or other seriousness criterion. He was home that afternoon and the headache resolved that evening.

Dr Ortiz and the MM discussed the intolerability that morning and agreed to interrupt study drug. We obtained an unscheduled PK sample during the visit and recorded the last dose time. The AE, treatment, interruption and outcome are in EDC. They reviewed again on 23 Sep and agreed to resume 200 mg on 24 Sep; he confirmed taking that dose yesterday. Blind isn't applicable to the ATE treatment, but no placebo-period allocation was requested.

Also closing your conmed query: rosuvastatin is continuing. The MM's individual review calls it wide therapeutic index for him, and the investigator has documented monitoring for the relevant adverse effects.

Regards,
Sam

subject: G-509-181: screening AE and optional sample notes
body:
Hi team,

For the 06 Oct data review, here's the reconciliation from yesterday.

G-509-181 signed Master consent on 01 Sep. On 02 Sep he called about a new mild rash; no study drug or G assignment yet. Dr Lin assessed it as an AE and we entered it with that onset date, rather than waiting for G consent. It resolved 04 Sep. Master eligibility was confirmed and G assignment completed 08 Sep; G consent was signed before the G screening/baseline on 09 Sep.

He agreed to optional DNA collection at baseline, but the sample wasn't obtained because we couldn't get another tube. We obtained the DNA sample on 05 Oct with his agreement still in place.

Also on 05 Oct he withdrew permission for future research use of his stored biofluid samples, not consent for the trial or DNA collection. We documented the scope carefully and notified the repository to stop future use of remaining stored biofluid samples. We explained that an aliquot already consumed in an assay could not be destroyed; he understood. His routine trial follow-up continues.

Can you check that the AE page and the sample-permission note are both in your review queue?

Rae

subject: G-516-039 — consent withdrawal contact log, no more outreach requested
body:

Thanks,
Amanda

subject: G-519-035 ATE nausea follow-up — off drug, still active

Dr. Chen
